mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, email, display_name, password_hash, status, platform_role, last_login_at, updated_at, locale, security_version, deleted_at FROM user_account WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_identity WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND identity_type = #{type} AND issuer = 'local' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_identity WHERE identity_type = #{type} AND issuer = 'local' AND normalized_identifier = #{identifier}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET display_name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_account SET locale = #{locale}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_identity SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{id} AND identity_type = #{type} AND issuer = 'local' AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_identity(id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{type}, 'local', #{identifier}, #{identifier}, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (identity_type, issuer, normalized_identifier) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, security_version = security_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_account SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, security_version = security_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_identity SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account WHERE platform_role = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_binding_rate_limit(budget_key, window_started_at, sends, next_allowed_at) VALUES(#{key}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{cooldown})) ON CONFLICT(budget_key) DO UPDATE SET sends = CASE WHEN email_binding_rate_limit.window_started_at + INTERVAL '1 hour' <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE email_binding_rate_limit.sends + 1 END, window_started_at = CASE WHEN email_binding_rate_limit.window_started_at + INTERVAL '1 hour' <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE email_binding_rate_limit.window_started_at END, next_allowed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{cooldown}) WHERE email_binding_rate_limit.next_allowed_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (email_binding_rate_limit.window_started_at + INTERVAL '1 hour' <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR email_binding_rate_limit.sends < #{limit})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_binding_challenge SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_binding_challenge(id, user_id, email_fingerprint, browser_fingerprint, code_digest, status, attempts, expires_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{emailFingerprint}, #{browserFingerprint}, #{codeDigest}, 'PENDING', 0, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_binding_challenge SET status = 'SENT' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE email_binding_challenge SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, email_fingerprint, browser_fingerprint, code_digest, status, attempts, expires_at FROM email_binding_challenge WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE email_binding_challenge SET attempts = attempts + 1, status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= 5 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE status END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENT'
UPDATE email_binding_challenge SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENT' AND attempts < 5 AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
